question: In which of the following Indian states will you find the Tibetan Buddhist Golden Temple?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Karnataka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tibetan Buddhist Golden Temple** is located in **Coorg, Karnataka.** 
 
• **The Namdroling Monastery** popularly referred to as ‘The Golden Temple is one of the largest Tibetan settlements in India.
 
• Thegchog Namdrol Shedrub Daryeling is the full name of the Namdroling Monastery.
 
• It is spread over an area of **80 square feet** and was built from Bamboo which was donated by the Indian Government to the Tibetans in exile.
 
• The foundation for this majestic monastery was laid down in **1963 **by His Holiness **Pema Norbu Rinpoche**, the 11th throne-holder of the Palyul Lineage of the Nyingma School of Tibetan Buddhism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
